ROOT.scriptdef: if exists (select name from sysobjects where name = 'POS_EksportOsobyKontaktowe' and type = 'P') drop procedure CDN.POS_EksportOsobyKontaktowe;

CREATE PROCEDURE [CDN].[POS_EksportOsobyKontaktowe] @rowVersion bigint, @PointOfSaleId int AS BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON;
declare @Typ_Osoba int = 8211
declare @LastMod bigint = isnull((select max(KnS_CzasModyfikacji) FROM CDN.POS_KntDoEksportu(@PointOfSaleId,0) JOIN CDN.KntOsoby ON KnS_KntNumer = KntGIDNumer where KnS_CzasModyfikacji > @rowVersion),@rowVersion)
SELECT @LastMod AS [@RowVersion] ,( select Kns_GUID as [@GUID], isnull(SUBSTRING(kns_nazwa, 1, CASE CHARINDEX(' ', kns_nazwa) WHEN 0 THEN LEN(kns_nazwa) ELSE CHARINDEX(' ', kns_nazwa) - 1 END),'') as [@FirstName], isnull(SUBSTRING(kns_nazwa, CASE CHARINDEX(' ', kns_nazwa) WHEN 0 THEN LEN(kns_nazwa) + 1 ELSE CHARINDEX(' ', kns_nazwa) + 1 END, 1000),'') as [@LastName], -- as [@TitleId] -- as [@FamilyRelationTypeId], NULL (select slw_id from cdn.Slowniki where SLW_Kategoria='Stanowiska' and SLW_WartoscS=KnS_Stanowisko) as [@PositionTypeId], -- as [@DateOfBirth], NULL CASE WHEN KnS_Archiwalny <> 0 THEN 'false' else 'true' end as [@IsActive], DATEADD(second,KnS_CzasModyfikacji,convert(datetime,'01-01-1990',105)) as [@ModificationDate], ( select kns_GUID as [@GUID], kntGUID as [@CustomerGUID], -- as [@FamilyRelationTypeId], (select slw_id from cdn.Slowniki where SLW_Kategoria='Stanowiska' and SLW_WartoscS=KnS_Stanowisko) as [@PositionTypeId], DATEADD(second,KnS_CzasModyfikacji,convert(datetime,'01-01-1990',105)) as [@ModificationDate], 'false' as [@IsDefault] for xml path('Customer'), root('Customers'), type ) FROM CDN.POS_KntDoEksportu(@PointOfSaleId,0) JOIN CDN.KntOsoby ON KnS_KntNumer = KntGIDNumer where KnS_CzasModyfikacji > @rowVersion for xml path('ContactPerson'), type) for xml path('ContactPersons') SET NOCOUNT OFF; END
GRANT EXECUTE ON CDN.POS_EksportOsobyKontaktowe TO CDNRaport
